name: Girls Nite Out
original_name: ガールズ・ナイト・アウト
source:
A middle school student plans to arson her father's house with the help of her friends. But setting his house on fire won't be enough without humiliating him first. They plan to enjoy it. 
Pervert father. Stupid teachers. How could arson be bad in this crazy world.
translation:
一名中学生计划在朋友帮助下纵火烧掉父亲的房子。但在羞辱父亲之前，仅仅烧掉房子还不够。她们打算好好享受这一切。

变态父亲。愚蠢教师。在这个疯狂的世界里，纵火怎么会是坏事？
